job.job_description:
Responsibilities:

Lead and conduct advanced research in generative AI, focusing on GANs, VAEs, and other state-of-the-art models.
Develop innovative algorithms and techniques to push the boundaries of generative AI.
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to apply generative models in various domains such as healthcare, finance, Power & utility, manufacturing and supply chain.
Design, develop, and deploy generative AI models for complex real-world applications.
Optimize models for performance, scalability, and robustness.
Implemented multimodal , Multi Agent/ Agentic AI in Gen AI.
Work closely with research scientists to implement cutting-edge generative algorithms.
Lead a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and mentorship.
Develop and maintain AI pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment.
Conduct thorough testing and validation of models to ensure high-quality outputs.
Mentor junior researchers and guide their projects.
Publish high-impact research papers in top-tier conferences and journals.
Stay abreast of the latest trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.



Qualifications:

Ph.D./Engineering /MCA in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
6-10 years of experience in AI research, with a strong focus on generative models.
Proven track record of publications in reputable conferences and journals.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience with large-scale data processing and model training.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
At least 5+ years of experience in Python/ Pyspark with hands on delivery experience; Pandas/ NumPy, TensorFlow, Flask/ FastAPI, scikit-learn
